run_opportunity_profile.note: Batting order changes both the game states a hitter encounters and the number of plate appearances he receives.

why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Pete Crow-Armstrong is slot #7 (4.784 expected team runs/game).
Slots #7, #8, #9, #6, #5, #3 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 9 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.019 R/G.
Slot #7 yields 4.06 expected PA/game vs 4.71 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Three True Outcomes (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.003 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
